title: Anvil Job Submission
text: Anvil jobs are submitted with sbatch. Every Anvil job must request an account and partition.

title: Anvil Allocation and Storage Policies
text: Anvil requires an ACCESS allocation before jobs can be submitted. CPU work is charged against ACCESS service units.

title: Anvil Allocation and Storage Policies
text: Files in Anvil scratch that have not been accessed for 60 days may be purged.
